mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, role) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, role, name, telegram, city, vk, grade, profile_consent_at FROM users WHERE username = #{username} COLLATE NOCASE
SELECT id, username, password_hash, role, name, telegram, city, vk, grade, profile_consent_at FROM users WHERE role = #{role} ORDER BY COALESCE(name, username) COLLATE NOCASE
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{name}, telegram = #{telegram}, city = #{city}, vk = #{vk}, grade = #{grade}, profile_consent_at = COALESCE(#{profileConsentAt}, profile_consent_at) WHERE id = #{id}
